title: Agent SDK Lab
description: Lab 3 of an AI Engineering curriculum: one triage agent built four ways (a hand-written loop, LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK and the Claude Agent SDK) on a shared tool core, compared with one framework-neutral eval covering outcome, trajectory, safety and completion, with negative controls. Three implementations run offline on a shared deterministic fake.
